title: Unit 19 Consolidation: Sociological Stratification, Class Structures & Social Mobility
goal: I can talk about social layers, inequality and mobility in Hungarian.
I can use *arányában* and *viszonylatában*, *-va/-ve* participles, *mindössze*, result participles and scalar adverbs.
I can say what a short text says about Erdei Ferenc's dual society.
